# uptimeify_maintenance_window (Data Source)

Look up one maintenance window by `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_maintenance_window" "patch_night" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric id or public id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `customer_id` (Number) Set only for a whole-customer window (no targets, no tags).
- `description` (String)
- `end_time` (String) UTC, RFC3339.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `public_id` (String)
- `recurrence_pattern` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurrence_pattern))
- `start_time` (String) UTC, RFC3339.
- `tag_ids` (Set of Number)
- `targets` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))
- `timezone` (String) IANA zone the recurrence is read in.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--recurrence_pattern"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurrence_pattern`

Read-Only:

- `day_of_month` (Number)
- `days_of_week` (List of Number)
- `end_recurrence_date` (String)
- `frequency` (String)
- `interval_count` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `type` (String)
